captions.detailed: A spoiler sunroof cassette assembly featuring a flat rectangular frame in matte grey aluminum with side guide rails. It holds a dark-tinted glass sunroof panel framed in black. The glass panel is designed to lift at its rear edge via a horizontal front hinge and simultaneously slide backward along the twin black guide rails on rolling shoe carriages.
captions.instruction: Generate a spoiler sunroof cassette with a rectangular aluminum frame, twin black guide rails, and a dark glass panel. The assembly must feature a prismatic joint for the sliding mechanism along the rails and a revolute joint at the front edge for tilting the panel.
captions.factory: Construct a base frame using a flat rectangular box with a central rectangular cutout, adding side holes and grooved patterns. Model the guide rails as long, thin parallel black boxes running along the sides. Create the sunroof panel by combining a semi-transparent glass box with a thin black perimeter frame. Define a prismatic joint along the longitudinal axis for the sliding motion, and a revolute joint along the lateral axis at the front for the tilting action.
